approved_customer_outcome_target.authorization: User adjusted accepted final customer failure target to 0.01%, noting it is better than their existing system. Applies after bounded recovery; correctness and other gates unchanged.
approved_customer_outcome_target.denominator: All dispatched customer journeys, including every final failed journey.
approved_customer_outcome_target.final_failure_definition: Customer journey that remains unsuccessful after bounded recovery or exceeds the current profile total journey deadline.
approved_customer_outcome_target.first_attempt_errors: Report separately with operation checks, recovery attempts, recovered journeys and total journey latency. No new numeric first-attempt ceiling was approved; preserve any existing profile overload gates.
approved_customer_outcome_target.undispatched_journeys: Report scheduled, dispatched and undispatched counts separately. Preserve existing dispatch gates; this approval does not permit generator drops.
approved_customer_outcome_target.latency_targets: Existing profile thresholds unchanged; include recovery in total customer journey latency.
approved_customer_outcome_target.enforcement_status: Implemented opt-in ADR0305 source-bound runner gate. Fresh ADR0306 profiles enforce 0.01%; historical and unselected profiles remain strict.
approved_customer_outcome_target.historical_results: Do not retroactively reclassify failed runs or claim production qualification from a short zero-failure sample.

target_revision_history.authorization: User confirmed recoverable first-attempt errors may occur provided recovery succeeds; final customer failures at or below 0.001%.
